title: Opening a Pocketwire Business Profile and Business Verification
content:
**Who can open a Pocketwire Business Profile.** A business profile is opened only by a customer whose personal account is active on Pocketwire Core or a higher plan with an identity verification status of verified. A Pocketwire Lite account, or a personal account that is limited, locked or closure pending, cannot open one. These conditions are read from the customer's Pocketwire Personal Account record, which is the account the profile is opened from.

| Personal account record shows | Can a profile be opened? |
|---|---|
| active, Pocketwire Core or a higher plan, identity verified | yes |
| on Pocketwire Lite | no |
| limited, locked or closure pending | no |

**How a new profile starts.** Every profile opens on Pocketwire Business Starter in applied status, with an opening balance of 0.00. Business verification checks the entity documents and, for any business other than a sole proprietor, the entity's tax identification, and it sets the profile to active or to closed:

- verification passed: the profile becomes active and can accept payments;
- verification declined: the profile is closed, with the decline date as its closure date.

A representative cannot activate a profile.
